newsitem.title: NORWAY: PGS board seeks new share, options issue.
newsitem.headline: PGS board seeks new share, options issue.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services and seismic group Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS) said on Thursday its board would propose it be given authorisation from shareholders to increase the group's equity capital by up to 50.85 million crowns at the annual general meeting on June 25.
A statement from PGS said the sum would be raised via one or more new subscriptions of up to 10.17 million shares, each with a nominal value of five crowns.

The board also will propose it be given authorisation to increase share capital in its stock options programme by up to 27 million crowns through one or more new subscriptions of up to 5.4 million shares of nominal value of five crowns per share.
PGS said the issue would cover 2.414 million options previously granted and the issuance of up to 2.986 million new options to be directed towards key employees.
